name: Headline figures
what: Projects by rating, revenue at risk, what changed, sites with a plan

name: Risk, time left and size
what: Every project by risk score and months left on the contract; the bubble is annual revenue

name: What changed
what: Projects whose score rose or fell since the last check and over 90 days

name: Direction of travel
what: Every project as one line over twelve months: which rose, which fell and which held

name: The project list
what: Every project with one score, its direction, what drives it, revenue and end date

name: Where the risk sits
what: Regions against factors: is a problem local or across the business

name: Mitigation plans
what: Every site with a signal at 3 or 4, its plan and what the plan would bring the score to

name: All projects at a glance
what: One square per project, by region

name: Where every signal comes from
what: Each signal, its source, the level it sits at, how many projects it covers

name: Tested against contracts already lost
what: What this scorecard would have said a year before each loss
